checkpoints.title: Foundation and Infrastructure
checkpoints.description: Bootstrap Next.js 15 project, migrate build configuration, set up TypeScript and Tailwind 4, create engine API Route Handlers proxy, and migrate shared type definitions. This checkpoint must produce a compilable Next.js project that can proxy all engine API calls.

tasks.title: Bootstrap Next.js 15 App Router project
tasks.description: Create a new Next.js 15 project using the App Router with TypeScript enabled. Configure next.config.js with output mode, basePath (replacing VITE BASE_URL), and any required redirects. Mirror the existing directory structure: app/ (pages), components/, lib/, types/, hooks/, context/.
acceptance_criteria: next build completes without errors
next dev starts and serves the root route
TypeScript compilation succeeds with strict mode
No VITE_* environment variables present

tasks.title: Migrate TypeScript configuration
tasks.description: Port tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.node.json strict settings into the Next.js tsconfig.json. Enable noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Remove vite-specific path aliases and replace with Next.js tsconfig paths. Fix any new TypeScript errors introduced by stricter settings.
acceptance_criteria: tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
noUncheckedIndexedAccess is enabled
Path aliases (@/ etc.) resolve correctly in Next.js

tasks.title: Migrate Tailwind CSS 3 to Tailwind CSS 4 (CSS-first config)
tasks.description: Upgrade tailwindcss to v4. Replace tailwind.config.js with a CSS-first configuration in the main CSS file (app/globals.css). Migrate custom theme extensions (colors, font sizes, animation) from tailwind.config.js to the new @theme directive. Verify all existing utility classes still render correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Tailwind 4 installed and compiles without errors
Custom theme tokens from tailwind.config.js (colors, fonts) available as CSS custom properties
All Tailwind utility classes from source/src/index.css preserved
No tailwind.config.js required at runtime

tasks.title: Migrate shared type definitions
tasks.description: Copy src/types/engine.ts and src/types/codeRepos.ts to the Next.js project (types/engine.ts, types/codeRepos.ts). Review types for any Vite-specific imports (import.meta.env types) and replace with Next.js equivalents. Ensure all 18 entity interfaces are preserved exactly.
acceptance_criteria: All 18 entity interfaces from source/src/types/engine.ts present
All code repo types from source/src/types/codeRepos.ts present
No vite-env.d.ts or import.meta references in type files
tsc compiles type files without errors

tasks.title: Migrate utility libraries (lib/)
tasks.description: Port src/lib/utils.ts, src/lib/credit-errors.ts, src/lib/code-repos.ts, src/lib/code-repo-file-utils.ts, src/lib/code-repo-line-highlight.ts, and src/lib/codeRepoChat.ts to the Next.js project. Remove any Vite-specific imports. These are pure utility modules with no side effects.
acceptance_criteria: All utility functions compile without errors
No import.meta.env references remain
cn() helper from utils.ts functions correctly with Tailwind 4 class names

tasks.title: Create engine API Route Handlers (server-side proxy)
tasks.description: Create Next.js Route Handlers under app/api/engine/[...path]/route.ts that proxy all requests to the ENGINE_URL server-side environment variable. This is the critical security fix for SEC-C-001: the engine URL is never sent to the browser. Implement: (1) generic REST proxy for all non-SSE endpoints; (2) SSE streaming proxy using Node.js ReadableStream passthrough for endpoints that return text/event-stream. Adapt src/lib/engineClient.ts to call /api/engine/... instead of VITE_ENGINE_URL directly.
acceptance_criteria: ENGINE_URL set only in server environment (not NEXT_PUBLIC_)
All engineClient.ts functions call /api/engine/... instead of VITE_ENGINE_URL
SSE streaming endpoints return proper text/event-stream response through Route Handler
next build succeeds with no environment variable warnings
Manual test: REST call to /api/engine/v1/users returns proxied response from engine

tasks.title: Configure environment variables and .env files
tasks.description: Replace all VITE_* environment variables with Next.js conventions. ENGINE_URL (server-only, no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix), CODEFLO_SHARE_KEY (server-only), NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH (public, replaces BASE_URL). Create .env.local.example and update README with new variable names. Audit the codebase for any remaining import.meta.env references and replace them.
acceptance_criteria: Zero import.meta.env references in the new codebase
ENGINE_URL is NOT prefixed with NEXT_PUBLIC_
next build does not embed ENGINE_URL in browser bundle
.env.local.example documents all required variables

tasks.title: Set up QueryClient and global providers
tasks.description: Create the React Query provider wrapper as a Client Component (components/providers/QueryProvider.tsx). Create the root app/layout.tsx that wraps the app in all providers (QueryProvider, ThemeProvider, AuthProvider, ShortcutsProvider). This replaces src/main.tsx and its provider tree. Configure QueryClient with the same default options as the source (staleTime, retry settings).
acceptance_criteria: Root layout compiles as a Server Component
QueryProvider is a 'use client' Client Component
useQuery hooks are functional in any page that uses them
next dev starts without React context errors

checkpoints.title: Auth, Admin, and Core UI
checkpoints.description: Migrate the authentication flows (SSO, password, admin key), all admin pages (Users, Roles, Audit, Credits), layout shell components, and shared UI primitives. The admin key must move to a server-side session cookie (fixing SEC-H-001). All pages must compile and render correctly.

tasks.title: Migrate authentication hook and context
tasks.description: Port src/hooks/useAuth.tsx to hooks/useAuth.tsx as a 'use client' hook. Adapt SSO flow: replace window.location.href assignment with Next.js router.replace() or a server action redirect where appropriate. Replace sessionStorage admin key storage with an HTTP-only cookie set via a Next.js Route Handler (POST /api/auth/admin-key) — this closes SEC-H-001. Implement sign-out as a Route Handler that clears the cookie.
acceptance_criteria: SSO login redirect works (window.location replaced with Next.js navigation)
Admin key is stored in an HttpOnly cookie, not sessionStorage
Sign-out clears the server-side cookie and redirects to /login
getAdminKey() reads from server context (cookie header), not sessionStorage
SEC-H-001 remediation verified: no admin key in sessionStorage

tasks.title: Migrate LoginPage
tasks.description: Port src/pages/LoginPage.tsx to app/login/page.tsx as a 'use client' Client Component. Implement all three auth modes: SSO (button triggers Route Handler redirect), password login (calls /api/engine/.../login), admin key (calls /api/auth/admin-key to store in HttpOnly cookie). Add client-side rate limiting on password auth (SEC-M-003): disable submit for 2 seconds after failed attempt. Add key format validation regex for admin key input (SEC-M-001).
acceptance_criteria: All three login modes functional
Password login submit button disabled for 2 seconds after failure
Admin key input shows validation warning for obviously invalid format
Redirect to dashboard on successful login
Page renders without hydration errors

tasks.title: Migrate layout shell components (AppLayout, Sidebar, Topbar)
tasks.description: Port src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx, Sidebar.tsx, Topbar.tsx, and AdminSectionLayout.tsx to the Next.js project. The layout shell wraps all authenticated routes via app/(authenticated)/layout.tsx. Sidebar and Topbar contain navigation links — replace React Router <Link> with Next.js <Link>. The RequireAdmin guard from App.tsx becomes middleware or a layout-level auth check.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated route group (authenticated) renders AppLayout for all child routes
Sidebar navigation links work with Next.js Link (no full-page reloads)
Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login via middleware
Admin-only routes redirect non-admin users

tasks.title: Migrate shared UI primitive components
tasks.description: Port all components in src/components/ui/ to components/ui/: Button.tsx, Input.tsx, Select.tsx, Badge.tsx, Card.tsx, Table.tsx, Spinner.tsx, AppLogo.tsx, LinedPanel.tsx, ApiErrorState.tsx, EmptyState.tsx, ErrorState.tsx, ShortcutsModal.tsx, ProfilePopover.tsx. These are pure presentational components with no routing or data-fetching. Remove any React Router or Vite-specific imports.
acceptance_criteria: All 14 UI primitive components compile without errors
Components render correctly in Storybook or manual visual check
No React Router Link or useNavigate imports in UI primitives
Tailwind 4 classes apply correctly to all components

tasks.title: Migrate theme and keyboard shortcut hooks
tasks.description: Port src/hooks/useTheme.tsx, src/hooks/useSidebarCollapse.tsx, src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts, src/hooks/useHighlightTheme.ts, and src/context/ShortcutsContext.tsx. These are 'use client' hooks. useTheme should use next-themes or a custom document-level class toggle that works with Next.js SSR (avoids flash of wrong theme).
acceptance_criteria: Dark/light theme toggle works without hydration flash
Keyboard shortcuts (documented in ShortcutsModal) function in client
Sidebar collapse state persists across navigation

tasks.title: Migrate DashboardPage
tasks.description: Port src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx (~428 lines) to app/(authenticated)/dashboard/page.tsx. This page can be a React Server Component that prefetches suite card data and passes it to a Client Component for interactivity. Replace all useQuery data fetching with server-side fetch calls in the RSC shell, passing initial data as props.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard renders suite cards with prefetched data (no loading spinner on first load)
Navigation to suite pages works
Your apps grid renders correctly
Page passes next build without warnings

tasks.title: Migrate admin pages: UsersPage and UserDetailPage
tasks.description: Port src/pages/UsersPage.tsx (~407 lines) and src/pages/UserDetailPage.tsx to app/(authenticated)/admin/users/page.tsx and app/(authenticated)/admin/users/[userId]/page.tsx. Increase password minimum length to 12 characters (SEC-L-003). User list table and inline role assignment must work with the Next.js App Router. Replace React Router useParams with Next.js params.
acceptance_criteria: User list renders with pagination
Inline role assignment works
Password minimum length enforced at 12 characters
useParams replaced with Next.js params prop

tasks.title: Migrate admin pages: RolesPage, AuditLogPage, CreditsPage
tasks.description: Port src/pages/RolesPage.tsx, src/pages/AuditLogPage.tsx, and src/pages/CreditsPage.tsx to app/(authenticated)/admin/roles/page.tsx, app/(authenticated)/admin/audit/page.tsx, and app/(authenticated)/admin/credits/page.tsx respectively. Also migrate related component folders: components/roles/ and components/credits/. These are stateless data table pages.
acceptance_criteria: All three admin pages render with real data from engine API
Role catalog display matches source app
Audit log pagination works
Spend cap display and topup request flow functional

tasks.title: Migrate MyProfilePage
tasks.description: Port src/pages/MyProfilePage.tsx to app/(authenticated)/profile/page.tsx. This is a self-service page showing the logged-in user's profile and own spend cap. No admin guard required.
acceptance_criteria: Profile page renders user info from /v1/me endpoint
Spend cap display matches source app
Page accessible to non-admin users

checkpoints.title: Feature Suites: Run Minds and CodeFlo+
checkpoints.description: Migrate the two largest feature suites: Run Minds (RunPage.tsx, 1,549 lines, includes SSE streaming) and CodeFlo+ (code repository browser, kanban, review). SSE streaming through the Route Handler proxy is the highest-risk work in this checkpoint. All pages must compile and SSE streaming must be functional.

tasks.title: Implement and test SSE streaming Route Handler
tasks.description: Before migrating RunPage, implement and verify the SSE proxy Route Handler from task_006 produces a working stream. Create a dedicated test harness page (app/sse-test/page.tsx, not shipped to production) that invokes a mind execution and logs each SSE event to the DOM. The Route Handler must use a ReadableStream that pipes the upstream SSE response event-by-event without buffering. Verify token streaming renders correctly.
acceptance_criteria: SSE test page shows streaming tokens arriving progressively in browser
Route Handler sets Content-Type: text/event-stream with no-cache headers
First token appears within 2 seconds of request start
Stream terminates cleanly on [DONE] event
No buffering: tokens arrive at the browser as they come from upstream

tasks.title: Migrate RunPage — Execute and Chat modes
tasks.description: Port src/pages/RunPage.tsx (~1,549 lines) to app/(authenticated)/run/[mindId]/page.tsx. This is the largest and most complex page. Split into sub-components: RunHeader, MindSelector, ExecuteForm, ChatInterface, SessionHistory, SessionDetail, ShareKeyPanel. Fix SEC-H-002: replace localStorage.setItem for the Mind Share Key with sessionStorage (or a server-side cookie via Route Handler). The ShareKeyPanel should default to sessionStorage only.
acceptance_criteria: Execute mode: form submits and SSE stream renders tokens progressively
Chat mode: message history renders correctly
Session history sidebar works
Mind Share Key stored in sessionStorage only (not localStorage) — SEC-H-002 fixed
Mind selector dropdown populated from /v1/minds endpoint
No hydration errors in next dev

tasks.title: Migrate CodeReposPage and CodeRepoViewerPage
tasks.description: Port src/pages/CodeReposPage.tsx and src/pages/CodeRepoViewerPage.tsx to app/(authenticated)/code-repos/page.tsx and app/(authenticated)/code-repos/[repoId]/page.tsx. The viewer has complex file tree navigation, pagination, and syntax highlighting via highlight.js. Preserve walk limits and file size guards from the source. Replace React Router route params with Next.js params.
acceptance_criteria: Code repo list renders with real data
File tree navigation works (expand/collapse, pagination)
File content viewer renders with syntax highlighting
Walk limits preserved (no runaway directory traversal)
Breadcrumb navigation functional

tasks.title: Migrate CodeRepoKanbanPage and CodeRepoReviewPage
tasks.description: Port src/pages/CodeRepoKanbanPage.tsx and src/pages/CodeRepoReviewPage.tsx to app/(authenticated)/code-repos/[repoId]/kanban/page.tsx and app/(authenticated)/code-repos/[repoId]/review/page.tsx. Preserve all review and kanban logic from the source. Migrate codeRepoChat.ts integration.
acceptance_criteria: Kanban board renders code repo tasks
Review page shows diff/review interface
Code repo chat integration functional via migrated codeRepoChat.ts
Pages compile without errors

checkpoints.title: DocFlo+, Polish, Security Hardening, and Testing
checkpoints.description: Migrate DocFlo+ pages (agents, chat, corpus), implement CSP headers and remaining security fixes, add comprehensive test suite (Vitest + Playwright), and perform final production hardening. This checkpoint closes all remaining security findings from the assessment and adds test coverage.

tasks.title: Migrate DocFlo pages (DocFloAgentsPage, DocFloAgentChatPage, DocFloCorpusPage)
tasks.description: Port src/pages/DocFloAgentsPage.tsx, src/pages/DocFloAgentChatPage.tsx, and src/pages/DocFloCorpusPage.tsx to app/(authenticated)/docflo/page.tsx, app/(authenticated)/docflo/[agentId]/chat/page.tsx, and app/(authenticated)/docflo/corpus/page.tsx. DocFlo chat also uses streaming — verify SSE stream works for DocFlo agent responses.
acceptance_criteria: DocFlo agent list renders
Agent chat works with streaming response
Corpus page renders document list
Navigation between DocFlo sections works
No hydration errors

tasks.title: Implement Content Security Policy headers
tasks.description: Configure CSP headers in next.config.js using the headers() function. CSP policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{nonce}'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' (engine calls go through Route Handlers so no direct engine origin needed from client); img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'. Also add X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy. This closes SEC-H-003 and SEC-L-002.
acceptance_criteria: next dev serves CSP header on all pages
Browser CSP report shows no violations on dashboard and run pages
X-Frame-Options: DENY present
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff present
No inline script errors caused by CSP

tasks.title: Implement key format validation and rate limiting
tasks.description: Add client-side key format validation to the admin key input in the LoginPage (regex: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}$). Add inline validation warning for obviously invalid formats before submitting. Implement client-side rate limiting on password login: after each failed attempt, record a timestamp in module state and disable the submit button for 2 seconds. These close SEC-M-001 and SEC-M-003.
acceptance_criteria: Admin key input shows 'Invalid key format' warning for strings < 20 chars or wrong charset
Password submit button disabled for 2 seconds after failed attempt
Validation does not block valid keys that match expected format
SEC-M-001 and SEC-M-003 documented as remediated

tasks.title: Add SSE integrity logging and TLS documentation
tasks.description: Add a production-safe telemetry hook for SSE parse failures in engineClient.ts: when JSON.parse fails in an SSE event handler, log an anonymized warning (no payload content) via a structured logger. Add infrastructure documentation (README deployment section) specifying TLS requirement between client and engine, CORS allow-list configuration on the engine, and SRI requirements for any CDN-loaded scripts. This addresses SEC-M-002.
acceptance_criteria: SSE parse failures produce a console.warn in development and a structured log event in production
No payload data included in the log event
Deployment README section documents TLS requirement and CORS config

tasks.title: Audit and pin lucide-react dependency
tasks.description: Run npm audit to check lucide-react ^1.32.0 for known vulnerabilities. Verify the package on npmjs.com for integrity. Pin to an exact stable version in package.json. Run npm ci to confirm lockfile is clean. This addresses SEC-L-001.
acceptance_criteria: npm audit returns zero high or critical vulnerabilities
lucide-react pinned to an exact version in package.json
All lucide-react icon imports work correctly after version pin

tasks.title: Add unit and component tests with Vitest
tasks.description: Set up Vitest with React Testing Library. Write unit tests for: engineClient.ts (mock fetch, test all exported functions), auth-validation.ts (key format regex, rate limit logic), credit-errors.ts (error message mapping), utils.ts (cn() helper). Write component tests for: Button, Input, LoginPage (form validation, submit behavior), ErrorState. Target >= 70% branch coverage on tested modules.
acceptance_criteria: vitest run completes with zero failures
>= 70% branch coverage on engineClient.ts
>= 70% branch coverage on auth-validation.ts
LoginPage tests cover SSO mode, password mode, admin key mode, and rate limiting

tasks.title: Add end-to-end tests with Playwright
tasks.description: Set up Playwright. Write E2E tests for critical user paths: (1) SSO login flow (mock SSO redirect), (2) password login with valid credentials, (3) execute a Mind and verify streaming output appears, (4) create a user as admin, (5) assign a role. Configure Playwright to run against next dev on a fixed port.
acceptance_criteria: playwright test runs all specs with zero failures against a running next dev instance
Login E2E covers SSO redirect and password flow
Run Mind E2E verifies at least one streaming token appears
Admin user create E2E creates and confirms a test user

tasks.title: Lighthouse CI performance audit
tasks.description: Run Lighthouse CI against the built Next.js app (next start). Audit dashboard page and run page. Target: Lighthouse performance score >= 85, accessibility >= 90, best practices >= 90. Fix any issues flagged (missing alt text, contrast failures, render-blocking resources). Document results.
acceptance_criteria: Lighthouse performance score >= 85 on dashboard and run pages
Lighthouse accessibility score >= 90
No critical accessibility violations (missing labels, contrast failures)
Results documented in docs/lighthouse-results.md

tasks.title: Final migration cutover and deployment validation
tasks.description: Merge migration/nextjs branch to main. Update CI/CD pipeline to use next build instead of vite build. Update Docker/deployment configuration to use next start. Validate that all environment variables are correctly injected at runtime (not build time) in staging. Perform a final round of manual smoke testing across all product suites. Remove the legacy Vite configuration files.
acceptance_criteria: next build succeeds in CI with no warnings
Deployed staging app passes all Playwright E2E tests
No VITE_* variables in deployment configuration
All 12 security findings from Task 4 documented as remediated or accepted
Legacy vite.config.ts and related files removed from repository
